name: Cooperative Christmas bird observations
description: Independent observers counted birds across localities and sent their results for joint publication in a recurring coordinated count.

date.label: 25 December 1900
date.basis: The cited historical account provides this date.

events.statement: Participants recorded birds in 25 localities in the United States and Canada on 25 December 1900.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest scoped episode established in these sources; not a global priority claim.

caveats: This was one organized recurring count, not the first community observation of birds. The historical count does not establish who was able to participate or make its observations a representative sample. Audubon publications differ in their retrospective total species count, so no species number is asserted.

research.note: Independent review checked the date, participants, locality count and invitation against the cited Audubon history; the species count remains omitted.
